summary.text: Rob Hutton is a Republican member of the Wisconsin Senate representing District 5, based in Brookfield, elected to the Senate in 2022.
He chairs the Committee on Universities and Technical Colleges and is vice-chair of the Committee on Transportation and Local Government.

paragraphs.text: Hutton was born in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, on April 7, 1967, and is married with four children.
He graduated from Brookfield East High School in 1985 and earned a B.A. in history from the University of Wisconsin-Whitewater in 1990.
The Legislature's page describes him as having 25 years of executive and business owner experience.
It says he was elected to the Waukesha County Board of Supervisors from 2005 to 2012 and to the Assembly from 2012 to 2018, before his election to the Senate in 2022.
He is a member of the Wisconsin Center District Board and co-chairs the Joint Review Committee on Criminal Penalties.
